summary.text: Andrea White is a Republican state representative from Ohio who has represented District 36 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner, she chairs the Children and Human Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Andrea White lives in Kettering, Ohio, and graduated from Centerville High School, according to Ballotpedia.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Wright State University, and her career experience includes working as a project coordinator for a statewide advocacy organization and owning a business.
Ballotpedia lists White's tenure in the Ohio House of Representatives as beginning in 2021, with her current District 36 term starting January 1, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session she chairs the Children and Human Services Committee and serves on the Energy, House Finance and House Health committees.
Rose Lounsbury (D) and Chuck Horn (Independent) are also on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
